note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.expected_behavior: Colloquial second-opinion ask on a PR of code: quality runs first by default and proposes problems as chains, then a fresh verifier verifies each chain and answers the three standing questions (did what was asked / added what was not asked / solved a smaller problem); other perspective agents only for distinct ways the PR could fail the goal, up to three lenses.

evals.prompt: Take a look at this plan the model produced
evals.expected_behavior: Casual 'take a look at X' on model output triggers independent re-verification.

evals.prompt: 模型說已經完成了，幫我 check 一下是不是真的
evals.expected_behavior: Post-'done' declaration: verify the completion claim independently, surfacing hallucinations and drift.
看一下 + an existing error is symptom-to-root-cause debugging — routes to /hunt.

evals.prompt: 看一下我的 claude 配置對不對
evals.expected_behavior: Auditing the user's own agent configuration routes to /health, not /review.

evals.prompt: 看一下這個 PR 是不是做過頭了，加了一堆防呆
evals.expected_behavior: Excess / over-defence question on a PR of code: quality then the verifier by default; standing question 2 is the review question; guards for unreachable states are problems with their cost as the impact.

Fast path: lenses chosen as on any path — quality then the verifier when the line is code, the verifier alone otherwise; existing tests run, no canary, short report, and the report says the fast path was taken.
